measures.id: Local Economic Development Act GRT Question
measures.title: Otero County Local Economic Development Act Gross Receipts Tax
measures.summary: Asks whether Otero County should impose a countywide local option gross receipts tax of one-eighth of one percent (0.125%, or 12.5 cents per $100 of taxable gross receipts) under the Local Economic Development Act. The revenue would be dedicated to economic development plans and projects, with arts and cultural districts, cultural facilities and retail businesses among the qualifying uses.
measures.yesMeans: Otero County would impose a 0.125% gross receipts tax dedicated to economic development projects.
measures.noMeans: Otero County would not impose this 0.125% gross receipts tax.
